videos.title: AI for the Air-Gapped Economy
videos.description:
Some of the most valuable data in the world can never leave the building. Defense contractors, banks, hospitals, and nuclear plants can’t simply send it to a cloud AI API.

That creates an opportunity to bring frontier AI inside those walls: on-prem models, deployment tooling, security accreditation, and hardware for the parts of the economy the cloud can’t reach.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

videos.title: AI for City Hall
videos.description:
In some cities, getting a building permit takes longer than building the house.

AI can help with plan reviews, zoning checks, inspections, licensing, public records, and other work that still happens largely by hand. There are 19,000 cities in America. City Hall could be one of the biggest untouched markets for AI.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

videos.title: LLMs That Write Well
videos.description:
LLMs have gotten much better at coding and math, but their writing increasingly sounds flat and robotic.

Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

Jonathan Lai, General Partner at a16z, on why some of the biggest games in the industry started as mods of other games.

The PUBG example traces back to Brendan Greene, known online as PlayerUnknown. He built a battle royale mod on top of DayZ, which was itself a mod for Arma 2. That concept became PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds.

Watch the full episode on The a16z Show.

videos.description:
When Mecka started, most robot data came from teleoperation, and it couldn’t scale. Josh Gao bet on egocentric data instead: first-person video of humans doing real tasks. Robots see the world from a POV, humans and humanoids share a form, so turn humans into a fleet the way Tesla turned drivers into one. Josh on why the bet is now spreading across the industry. 

#Robotics #Humanoids #PhysicalAI

Ronak, co-founder of Trajectory, explains why closing that loop is the next learning paradigm, and why training your own model, which used to take a dedicated research team, months of work and hundreds of millions in compute, is now something a company can do in a few clicks with their own data. He details two research bets they are making available to everyone with their product: 1) a variant of GRPO that removes the need for a simulated environment by learning from single real-world rollouts instead of 16 replays of the same task, and 1) a meta-grader that increased data efficiency by 100x. His co-founder built a stablecoin that sold to Coinbase and was top 1,000 in four competitive games. #Founders #Robotics #Startups

#AI #infrastructure #leadership

LLMs got a free cold start from the internet. Robotics didn’t. Mecka’s answer runs end to end: build the wearable hardware, run the collection, own the quality gates.
